title: Parametric Phone Case Generator with Hinged Lid
author: Manufact3D_HH
description:
**Welcome to my MakerWorld page!**

Here you will find high-quality, cleanly designed, and everyday 3D models – developed with a focus on function, reliability, and straightforward printing.

## 📱 Parametric Smartphone Framework – "The Final Boss" Lid Edition

**Everything is customizable! Literally EVERYTHING!!!**

**Optimized for all materials:** PETG, PLA, TPU, ASA, ABS, and more.

This OpenSCAD script is the ultimate evolution of 3D-printed phone protection. It features a **fully integrated, hinged armor lid** with a secure snap-lock mechanism. Take total control over every millimeter and axis.

### 1\. Integrated Armor Lid & Hinge System 🛡️

The standout feature: A rugged, flip-to-open protective cover.

- **Flip-to-Print:** Optimized 180° flat-lay orientation for clean, support-free printing.
- **Precision Hinges:** Adjustable hinge length, diameter, and clearance for a smooth swing.
- **Secure Snap-Lock:** A reinforced tactical latch keeps the lid closed during drops.

### 2\. Comprehensive XYZ Position Control 🕹️

No cutout is fixed. Every element (Buttons, USB, Speakers, AUX, IR) has its own dedicated sliders:

- **X-Axis:** Lateral shifting (e.g., for off-center USB ports).
- **Y-Axis:** Precise button positioning along the frame.
- **Z-Axis:** Vertical offset. Port too low? Just slide it down by 0.5 mm.

### 3\. Dynamic Dimensioning (L x W x H) 📏

From tiny mute switches to massive volume rockers:

- **Individual Specs:** Define length, width, and height for every button slot separately.
- **Radius Control:** Tune the roundness of cutouts for a premium look and feel.

### 4\. Smart-Flex Zone with Structural Integrity 🦾

The case balances flexibility with maximum protection:

- **Reinforced Corners:** Critical zones remain solid for peak drop protection.
- **Automatic Bridge Guards:** The script identifies button/port locations and maintains safety bridges to prevent stretching or snapping.

### 5\. Professional Finish & Ergonomics ✨

- **Global Scoop Slider:** Controls the ergonomic "depth" of all buttons for perfect tactile feedback.
- **Smooth Spherical Edges:** All internal cutout edges are rounded via spherical algorithms—no sharp edges for your fingers.
- **Minkowski Finish:** The entire exterior is organically rounded for the best in-hand feel.

**The Bottom Line:** You no longer adapt to the design – the design adapts to your phone. Enter your dimensions, and in seconds, you have a custom-armored case that fits better than any mass-produced product.
